title: Poplar: Ancient Poplars You Can Visit
meta_description: A poplar that survived the 2011 tsunami half underwater, a car-ad celebrity in Hokkaido, and a Dutch monument nobody has identified. Three mapped so far.
intro: Poplars grow fast and die young, which is exactly why the three mapped here stand out: each has outlasted the ordinary run for the genus by decades. None of them is famous for its age. Ofunato's Dokonjo Poplar took the 2011 tsunami half underwater and kept standing, and the city built a memorial plaza around it. Biei's Ken and Mary Tree was just a farm boundary marker until a 1972 car commercial made it one of the most photographed trees in Hokkaido. Arnhem's Wagnerlaan Poplar has an official monument listing and nothing else, not even a settled species. That last gap runs through all three: the sources checked cannot say which poplar any of them is, only that each is a Populus. If you know one on sight, the page says so and asks.
